concepts.anchor: ## Sources, alongside the existing Braintree Transaction-Level Fee Report route
concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-braintree-articles-br-reporting-reconciliation-transaction-level-fee-report]] - 2026-09-16 Braintree Brazil-route Document Version 1.0 for pricing-dependent transaction-fee detail, installment disbursement/adjustment fee matching and qualified Funds Anticipation fields; the page states no currency or account-program rule, does not override the separate IC+ no-reconciliation limit, and is not payout or bank-arrival proof
warnings: Keep the source route Brazil-specific and preserve the absence of a currency, merchant-account-program, precision and rounding rule.

The Brazil page's pricing-model language and unqualified installment reconciliation steps do not override the separately collected general report page, which limits default Brazil availability to flat-rate/blended pricing and says IC+ interchange estimates must not be used for reconciliation.
Treat the report's field table as a locator rather than proof that Samsung Pay or Bank Account is supported, because those rows are absent from the report-definition support list.
Do not infer transaction execution, settlement, disbursement, refund completion or bank arrival from report rows, formulas, a Funds Anticipation schedule or cross-report equality.
